text: Rust has been the most loved language in the Stack Overflow Survey for 8 years running.
Git was created by Linus Torvalds in just 10 days, back in 2005.
The first documented software bug was, literally, a moth trapped in a relay, in 1947.
TypeScript was released by Microsoft in 2012 as a superset of JavaScript.
HTTP/3 runs on QUIC over UDP instead of TCP, for faster connections.
Regular expressions trace back to the finite automata described by Stephen Kleene in the 1950s.
Docker popularized containers, but Linux cgroups have existed since 2006.
Python was named after Monty Python, not the snake.
An SSD has no moving parts, which is why it's far more shock-resistant than an HDD.
The first commit to the Linux kernel was made by Linus Torvalds in 1991.
The transformer architecture behind modern LLMs was introduced in the 2017 paper 'Attention Is All You Need'.
GPUs became the workhorse of AI because matrix multiplication parallelizes almost perfectly.
The term 'artificial intelligence' was coined for the 1956 Dartmouth workshop.
An LLM doesn't see words — it sees tokens, often chunks of 3-4 characters.
Backpropagation, the algorithm that trains neural networks, was popularized in 1986 by Rumelhart, Hinton and Williams.
ELIZA, the first famous chatbot, was built at MIT in 1966 — and users confided in it anyway.
Git bisect binary-searches your history to find the commit that introduced a bug.
console.table() prints arrays of objects as a readable table in any browser console and Node.
git commit --fixup plus rebase --autosquash keeps review-fix commits tidy automatically.
curl -w '%{time_total}' measures request latency without any extra tooling.
In VS Code, Ctrl+Shift+L selects every occurrence of the current word for multi-cursor editing.
JSON.stringify takes a third argument for pretty-printing: JSON.stringify(obj, null, 2).
A well-written commit message explains why, not what — the diff already shows the what.
SQLite is the most deployed database in the world — it ships in every phone and browser.
The 404 error code simply means 'not found' — the myth about a Room 404 at CERN is itself a 404.
Unicode has over 149,000 characters; UTF-8 encodes them all while staying ASCII-compatible.
The NYSE opening bell rings at 9:30 AM ET; after-hours trading runs until 8 PM.
A stock split changes the share price but not the company's market cap.
The S&P 500 has averaged roughly 10% annual returns since 1926, before inflation.
Ctrl+R in your shell reverse-searches command history — stop retyping long commands.
